name: utility-belt
description: Open-source Agent Skills that need no API keys: web search, extraction, crawling, scraping and browsing; YouTube, podcasts and local transcription; papers, citations, Wikipedia, Hacker News, Telegram, weather; writing, PDFs and Anki decks. One plugin per skill.

plugins.name: anki-deck
plugins.description: Anki flashcard decks (.apkg) from Markdown, CSV or JSON, rebuildable without duplicate cards.

plugins.name: cite-check
plugins.description: Checks references and DOIs against doi.org, Crossref, arXiv and PubMed; flags made-up citations.

plugins.name: hackernews
plugins.description: Hacker News search, front page, Show/Ask HN and full comment threads through the official APIs.

plugins.name: human-writing
plugins.description: Writes and reviews English articles, posts and docs: facts ledger, AI-tell linter, reviewer panel.

plugins.name: pdf-typeset
plugins.description: Markdown or JSON to checked, professional PDFs with Typst: reports, letters, invoices, CVs, slides.

plugins.name: podcast-search
plugins.description: Finds podcasts and episodes through Apple's public search and the show's RSS feed, with audio URLs.

plugins.name: scholar-search
plugins.description: Finds real papers across arXiv, Crossref, Europe PMC, PubMed and bioRxiv, with citations and BibTeX.

plugins.name: telegram-channel
plugins.description: Reads public Telegram channels without an account: posts, dates, views, links, search.

plugins.name: transcribe-audio
plugins.description: Transcribes audio or video locally with faster-whisper: text, timestamps, SRT, VTT; no upload.

plugins.name: wayback
plugins.description: Wayback Machine: whether a URL was archived, captures by date, what a page said, Save Page Now.

plugins.name: weather
plugins.description: Forecast, past weather back to 1940 and air quality for any place, from Open-Meteo.

plugins.name: web-browse
plugins.description: Drives a real local Chromium step by step: open, click, type, read, screenshot, keep logins.

plugins.name: web-crawl
plugins.description: Crawls a site into one Markdown file or JSONL, or maps its URLs; honours robots.txt.

plugins.name: web-extract
plugins.description: Reads a web page or PDF as clean Markdown with a browser-grade TLS fingerprint and a Wayback fallback.

plugins.name: web-scrape
plugins.description: Scrapes repeating records, tables and JSON-LD into CSV, JSON or JSONL, with pagination.

plugins.name: web-search
plugins.description: Web search without an API key through DuckDuckGo, Bing, Brave and others, or your own SearXNG.

plugins.name: wiki-lookup
plugins.description: Wikipedia in any language and Wikidata facts, with revision ids for citing.

plugins.name: youtube-audio
plugins.description: Saves YouTube audio as m4a or mp3 with chapters and cover art; cuts sections, splits tracks.

plugins.name: youtube-search
plugins.description: Searches YouTube without an API key, with dates, views and durations; sort and filter.

plugins.name: youtube-transcript
plugins.description: YouTube transcripts as text, timestamps, SRT or JSON, for summaries, notes and quotes.
